_help: events: fill = USDT added to the buffer. withdraw = USDT sold for INR (inr optional; if left out it is estimated at p2p_rate and shown as est). harvest = coins sold into the vault on 1 Nov: usdt received, sell_btc_usd, sell_bnb_usd and p_after_usd (post-harvest portfolio value); it adds to the buffer and raises the high watermark automatically. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. active_level = tier you are PAYING at (set on 1 Nov; on a downgrade it stays high until buffer runway < 24 months). snapshot_level = tier of the last 1 Nov snapshot, which sets the vault target (defaults to active_level). prior_cycle_high_usd = starting high watermark; the dashboard raises it to the largest p_after_usd of any harvest you log.
